customer: Selling my pickup since we're down to one car, but I can't find the title. What do I do? I'm in Georgia.
agent: Per our article "Getting a duplicate title in Georgia," you'll need to apply for a duplicate paper title. The application must be signed by every owner listed on the title and notarized, then mailed or taken to a Georgia motor vehicle office, and duplicates take 2 to 3 weeks. You can still get an offer and book an appointment with us while you wait. If one of the owners can't sign, check our article "When more than one person owns the car."
